content.text: You're a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-digital-product-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-8|USDT Payment]]-solutions-west-africa-works|digital]] creator in Nigeria, locked out of Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad. You've tried workarounds, but they fail when the platforms change their rules. You need infrastructure that's not rented, but owned. You need a digital store that accepts crypto payments, with data ownership and no subscriptions. This is how deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free works, and how to deploy it today without relying on Stripe.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The problem with renting platforms is that you're at their mercy. When they change their rules, your store is shut down. But with Cloudflare Pages, you own the infrastructure. You're not dependent on a platform's APIs or fees. You can customize your store to accept crypto payments, and control your data. With Stack 01, you can deploy a digital store in 4-6 hours, following the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-honest-side-side-2|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]] Blueprint. This infrastructure is not a workaround, but a base-layer solution that gives you full control over your online presence.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy, you need a hosting platform that's free and scalable. Cloudflare Pages meets this requirement. You also need a payment processor that accepts crypto, without KYC or fees. NOWPayments is the solution. With Stack 01, you can configure NOWPayments to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, with a 0.5% fee. This setup is not complicated, and can be done in under an hour.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you need to configure Cloudflare Workers to interact with Supabase. This is where the magic happens. With Stack 02, COREMERCH deploys this setup in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. With Stack 01, you can do it yourself in under a day. Once set up, you can start processing transactions and delivering digital products to your customers.
You own the infrastructure with Cloudflare Pages, not a rented platform.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Testing before promotion is not optional — it is the step that determines whether your store functions correctly under real conditions before real buyers encounter it. The test sequence has four steps. First: deploy the backend and confirm the webhook endpoint returns a valid response to a test HTTP POST. Second: configure the storefront and confirm the checkout displays correctly on desktop and mobile. Third: complete a real mainnet transaction with a small amount of actual crypto. Fourth: check your order database and confirm the order was logged correctly, the delivery email arrived, and the download link works.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Stack 01 is a basic setup that's deployed in 4-6 hours.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages, follow these steps: Set up a GitHub account and create a new repository for your store. Configure Cloudflare Pages to host your store. Set up a NOWPayments account and configure it to accept crypto payments. Deploy Stack 01 using the Sovereign Blueprint. Test your payment and delivery pipeline on mainnet. Promote your store to attract more customers.
